title: Traffic Sign Detection System
description: Context: ADAS prototypes need fast, accurate road-sign recognition across varied lighting and weather. Contribution: Led dataset curation, model training and web deployment using YOLOv8 + MobileNet/ResNet backbones served via Flask. Impact: Real-time detection at ~30 FPS with 92%+ mAP across 40+ sign classes, deployed as a live web demo.

title: Gemini Health AI Assistant
description: Context: People struggle to translate raw vitals and BMI numbers into actionable wellness guidance. Contribution: Sole developer — designed prompts, UX and the Gemini Pro integration on a Streamlit front end. Impact: Personalised wellness recommendations adopted by 50+ beta testers, reducing time-to-insight from minutes to seconds.

title: Medical Chatbot (RAG)
description: Context: Generic LLMs hallucinate on clinical questions, limiting trust in patient-facing assistants. Contribution: Built an end-to-end retrieval-augmented pipeline with LangChain, Pinecone vector store and HuggingFace embeddings served via Flask. Impact: Source-cited answers from a 700+ page medical corpus with sub-2-second latency.

title: FoodHub — Food Delivery Platform
description: Context: Local restaurants needed an affordable end-to-end ordering and tracking platform. Contribution: Full-stack lead across auth, checkout, order tracking and the provider dashboard on a MERN stack. Impact: Production-ready platform handling concurrent orders with secure JWT auth and real-time order tracking.

title: Vehicle Rental REST API
description: Context: Rental businesses lacked a clean, well-documented backend for fleet operations. Contribution: Backend engineer — designed dependency-injection architecture, middleware, API surface and Swagger docs in Go. Impact: Industry-grade API with JWT-secured endpoints and full Swagger documentation for partners.

title: EduBridge — Learning Platform
description: Context: Students needed a single hub for course content, enrolment and progress tracking. Contribution: Full-stack developer across auth, course module and progress dashboard on a React + Laravel stack. Impact: Multi-role learning platform with course enrolment, progress tracking and an admin panel.
